facts.text: The hotel is set steps away from the Heydar Aliyev Cultural Center in Baku.
facts.excerpt: Set steps away from the Heydar Aliyev Cultural Center, The Ritz-Carlton, Baku offers an inviting retreat in the heart of Azerbaijan's vibrant capital.

facts.text: The rooms were designed by Kristina Zanic Consultants using a visual language rooted in Azerbaijani craft.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Kristina Zanic Consultants using a visual language rooted in Azerbaijani craft

facts.text: In select rooms, a private balcony frames the Heydar Aliyev Cultural Center.
facts.excerpt: In select rooms, a private balcony frames the Heydar Aliyev Cultural Center

facts.text: The Blind Tiger is Azerbaijan's first speakeasy bar, behind a quiet door off the lobby.
facts.excerpt: The Blind Tiger is Azerbaijan's first speakeasy bar, a quiet door off the lobby

facts.text: Tribeca is an American brasserie whose kitchen draws from the hotel's own Mystique Garden.
facts.excerpt: Tribeca is an American brasserie open from early morning through late evening, where the kitchen draws from the hotel's own Mystique Garden

facts.text: The spa has two heated indoor pools, one for the whole family and one for adults only.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Baku features 2-indoor pools. One for the whole family and the other dedicated to adults only.

facts.text: The spa offers an ancestral oil ritual drawing on the heritage of Naftalan.
facts.excerpt: An ancestral oil ritual, drawing from the ancient heritage of Naftalan, anchors your transition into quiet.

facts.text: The one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments each have a fully equipped kitchen, private bathrooms for every bedroom and in-room laundry.
facts.excerpt: Our one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, each with a fully equipped kitchen, private bathrooms for every bedroom and in-room laundry

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 13th floor and has a 180-degree panoramic view of the city.
facts.excerpt: View situated on the 13th floor, the Club Lounge offers a 180-degree panoramic view of the city.

facts.text: A clay atelier experience lets guests shape and decorate a piece at a local atelier rooted in Azerbaijan's ceramic heritage.
facts.excerpt: Creating by hand at a local clay atelier rooted in Azerbaijan's ceramic heritage.

facts.text: The Blind Tiger Cocktail Journey has six cocktails, each representing one of the world's remaining tiger species.
facts.excerpt: Six cocktails. Six tigers. Each drink in the Journey represents one of the world's remaining tiger species

facts.text: Families have access to a dedicated children's pool.
facts.excerpt: families enjoy access to a dedicated children's pool

facts.text: The kitchen grows herbs in an on-site Mystique Garden.
facts.excerpt: an on-site herb Mystique Garden for the kitchen

facts.text: The hotel is 24.5 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport.
The Signature Journey brings Michelin-starred and Top 50 chefs to Baku for exclusive dinners and masterclasses.
facts.excerpt: The Signature Journey brings Michelin-starred and Top 50 chefs to Baku for exclusive dinners and masterclasses.

facts.text: The hotel runs a complimentary shuttle to Boulevard Park and the Maiden Tower at the Old City.
facts.excerpt: our complimentary daily shuttle makes that easier

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.
